about_the_game:
For the last 3 decades, the little hamlet of VeilWood has been isolated from the rest of the world by a strange blue fog. Prolonged exposure to the haze has twisted the local wildlife into bizarre creatures. Solve the mysteries of the town and investigate the cause behind the mist distorting the region or grow complacent as the new town farmer.

  • Grow crops: Cultivate over 40 unique crops, each with their own growing conditions and effects.

  • Engage with diverse creatures: Protect yourself and your harvest from over 15 unique creatures, each with variants that offer unique twists on their behavior.

  • Solve various puzzles: Beneath the town lies a long-forgotten labyrinth, housing various complex puzzles and secrets. Use what you find (or grow) above to help overcome the obstacles of The Catacombs

  • Defend your estate: With only your garden tools and a few bullets at your disposal, protecting your harvest becomes a blend of thoughtful structure placement and first-person combat.

  • Decorate your estate: Make your farm unique through the use of various vanity and decor options.

  • Pets: Become acquainted and bond with a pet; Each one offering unique benefits.

  • Catch bugs: VeilWood is home to a vast amount of bugs to catch. Some (one) would say they hold mistical powers within...

  • Care for your own Critters: Not all of the fauna is so bad. Raise them as your own to reap their benefits.

  • Play at your own pace: VeilWood's difficulty dynamically scales with your farm size. Up for a challenge? See how many crops you can grow in one night without your farm being reduced to rubble and flames.

  • Various game modes: Want to test your farming and strategy prowess? Try a hand at Arcade Mode, where you are tasked with meeting a constantly increasing money threshold. If fast paced decision making and strict time management is not your style, try Relaxed Mode: A more forgiving difficulty option for those who want a more casual experience.
